newsitem.title: USA: Air Products named in class action suit.
newsitem.headline: Air Products named in class action suit.

text.p: A class action was filed Wednesday against Air Products and Chemicals Inc on behalf of all current and former employees over the potential forfeiture of stock options, plaintiff lawyers said on Thursday.

The suit, filed in the United States District Court for the Eastern District of Pennsylvania, charges Air Products and certain of its officers with allegedly misrepresenting material information concerning the company's Long-Term Incentive Plan.
Law firms Berger & Montague PC and Jeffrey & Dreher LLP, alleged Air Products concealed the fact that plaintiff and the class would forfeit their stock options upon death, disability or retirement.
An Air Products spokesman refused to comment about the suit, noting that he had not yet seen the details of the suit.
